title: 第四章 哦呼
content_zh:
单面镜后，尴尬的死寂之中，特事处所有人都忍不住去摸了摸腰间的配枪，想要在这个消息传播出去之前把那个丢人玩意儿灭了口。
只有艾晴依旧淡定，只是端起咖啡喝了一口，然后，从轮椅的夹袋里掏出了一副厚重的墨镜戴在自己的脸上。
“继续。”
中年人犹豫了一下，叹息一声，通过桌子上的话筒下令：“继续。”
过了好半天，一哥才从如此尴尬地相逢之中反应过来，撩了一下垂在眼前的头发，和煦地微笑着，伸手过来：
“小兄弟认识一下，我叫柳东黎……”
“屁咧！鬼才要和你认识！”
槐诗大怒，现在他终于反应过来了，被拷住的手指着柳东黎，向着门外大喊：“领导同志，我要举报，这个人从事非法行业，简直是牛郎魁首……你们可不要被他骗了！”
“……”
柳东黎无奈叹息了一声，忽然抬起一根手指，放在槐诗面前：“看我的手指。”
“我不！”
槐诗就算是再傻也知道不对了，哪里愿意往他的坑里跳，直接抬起头，却一不小心……看到了他的脸。
那白皙的肌肤和修长的脖颈，一双深沉如海洋的眼眸，隐藏在长发之间的几缕金色好似宇宙中闪烁的星光，几缕发丝落在他的眉间，遮住了那一双宛如冬夜寒星的眼眸，高挺笔直的鼻梁显示出男性的刚美之气……
“哦呼！”
槐诗一时间竟然看得痴了，只是不知道为什么，忽然很反胃。
他暗自谴责自己，怎么能看到比自己好看的人就这么丑陋，铁青的脸上艰难挤出了一个笑容，可口水却从嘴角漏了出来……
整个人在瞬间痴呆化了。
握住了柳东黎的小手儿揉来揉去不放松，嘴里熟稔地套着近乎：“大哥你在哪里上班啊，哎呀，上次那么没礼貌真是不好意思，自我介绍一下，小弟槐诗，今年十七，你还记得我吧？”
“……”
此刻不止是槐诗，单面镜之后，所有看到柳东黎的人，都不由自主地’哦呼’了一声，哪怕是一直以来在最严肃的中年人也老脸一红，心中一荡，别过头轻声咳嗽了一下。

只有带着大号墨镜的艾晴依旧淡定如斯地喝着咖啡，伸手按住了通话按钮：“叫你来不是让你发浪的，把你的灵魂辐射收敛一点，办正事儿。”
“好好好。”
柳东黎抬起手指扶了一下鼻梁上的黑框眼镜，坐在槐诗对面，笑容温和如秋水，开口问道：“小兄弟我们也算是认识了，回答我几个问题好不好啊？”
“好呀好呀。”
槐诗抓着他的手不松开，流着口水，一脸痴呆像：“大哥你问什么我都告诉你，我的银行卡密码是18191……”
“咳咳，这个就不必了。”
柳东黎连忙摆手，然后掀开手里的档案本，轻咳一声：“昨天晚上你在哪里？”
“在家啊，睡觉，做了好几个噩梦，把我吓死了，我跟你讲啊……”
“只睡觉？”柳东黎没兴趣听他做了什么噩梦，打断问道。
“对啊。”
槐诗点头，“谁半夜闲着没事儿吓跑啊，而且昨晚还那么大的雨，神经病了才出门，我跟你说啊，我们家虽然破了点，但祖上好歹……”
“咳咳，下一个问题。”柳东黎再次打断了他的话：“你送到警局里的那个盒子里究竟是什么？”
“不知道。”槐诗干脆利落地摇头：“谁闲着没事儿去上来，对着人狂吐血……”
接下来的一个小时，柳东黎又反复地将档案中的问题繁复询问，打乱了次序，甚至忽然提问无关的问题。
直到单面镜之后传来艾晴的声音：“可以了。”
他终于松了口气，鼓劲儿把自己的手腕从槐诗的手里拔出来，被捏满了红印子，幸好拔得早，再晚一点就要让这孙子给揉断了。
就在他长出了一口气的瞬间，槐诗忽然从痴呆之中醒来，呆滞地看着他，不知道究竟发生了什么事情。
就好像做了一个噩梦，一个无比真实，真实到让他开始要唾弃自己的噩梦……
“呕！”
他猛然从椅子上起身，被铐着又起不来，狼狈地弯腰剧烈呕吐起来，一想到刚刚自己简直像是发春一样的样子就觉得难以言喻的反胃，吐到鼻涕眼泪都快流出来了。

“死变态，你对我做了什么！呕！”
话没说完，又吐了起来，吐着吐着忍不住哭了起来。
“妈呀，我连女朋友都没有，怎么就给这死变态给掰弯了呢？清名丧尽，清名丧尽啊，我他妈跟你这王八蛋拼了！”
“抱歉，发生这种事情大家都不想的。”
柳东黎好像早就习惯了这样的场面，同情地递上一杯水：“做人呢，最重要的就是开心，你肚子饿不饿，我……”
“呕！”
话没说完，槐诗又吐了。
此刻单面镜后面，也是一片呕吐和反胃的声音。
中年人的脸色铁青，按着剧痛的胃部，旁边的人递过来一颗胃药和一杯放得正好的温开水。
是艾晴身后那个一直沉默跟在她身边的女司机。
“谢谢。”他勉强地笑了笑，把药吃了，喘了半天气，才终于平静了一点。
“怎么样？”艾晴说，“我早说了，什么都问不出来。”
“说不定是装得……”
中年人干咳了一声：“柳东黎的灵魂能力我知道，魅惑效果是吧？对普通人虽然有效，但升华者未必会上套。”
“中没中招柳东黎还能不清楚么？况且，如果有哪个男人，哪个正处于自尊心和中二欲最旺盛阶段的男人能装到这种程度……我觉得你再想什么办法也问不出来。”
艾晴深深看了他一眼，“放弃吧。”
“档案我看了，如果说那小鬼的犯罪嫌疑，我其实是他的不在场证明才对。”
柳东黎从审讯室走了进来，将手里记满了的档案丢回桌子上，无奈感慨了一声：“那小鬼在港口爆炸的三分钟前还在我们会所面试来着……”
“面试？他能面试什么？”
”做牛郎……好像是被中介诓骗过来的吧？面到一半才发现，被主管吓走了。”

柳东黎摇头，看着档案上槐诗的正面照片，捏着下巴啧啧感叹：“要我说，他还挺有潜质的，架子好，可惜穿搭不行，换一身修身的西装礼服，把脸上那种死皮赖脸的笑去掉的话，就是活脱脱的禁欲系，老阿姨们最喜欢这种吃不到嘴里的小刺猬……”
“行了，叫你来不是找你给他做职业规划。”
艾晴打断了他的话，“只不过是一个不小心被卷入事件的普通人而已，签了保密协议之后让他走人吧，留下来也是浪费时间。”
事情就这么决定了。
十五分钟之后，心灵饱受蹂躏地槐诗又在签了一大堆东西之后被塞进车里送走了。
而在大门前，柳东黎的手插在口袋里，眺望着那个以为自己要被送去枪毙的少年狠命挣扎的样子，忍不住扑哧一声笑了起来。
“对了，他叫什么名字来着？”他看向身后的艾晴。
“槐诗。”
“你认识？”柳东黎神秘地笑了起来，“所以才帮他开脱的吧？可别低估金牌牛郎的直觉啊，艾小姐。”
出乎预料，艾晴的神情依旧平静。
“啊，算是认识吧。”
“很熟？”
“说不上，我大他三岁，小的时候和他玩得还算不错。”
“诶？”柳东黎惊奇地回过头，从没想过两人之间竟然有如此渊源：“后来呢？”
“后来？”
艾晴看了他一眼，“后来他家因为我祖父背信违约而破产之后，我们就没见过了。”
“……”
柳东黎愣住了，不知道该说什么好。
封闭的地下室中，有人推门而入。
坐立不安的男人从椅子上跳起来，神情惶急：“怎么这么晚？”

“你以为昨晚的动静很小没人发现么？”染血的凶猿蹲在椅子上，咯咯怪笑着，“托你的福，我可过了好一把手瘾……”
“东西呢？”
男人焦急地伸出手：“东西拿回来了么？”
一个被血浸透的塑料袋子丢进了他的怀里，“物归原主，只不过……”
那个人先是大喜，可接过袋子的一瞬间，脸色就变了，他发疯一样地扯开袋子，捧出了那个黑色的铁盒，小心翼翼地
可里面却空空荡荡。
“东西呢？！”
他尖叫：“里面的源质呢？我放牧这么久积攒的源质去哪儿了？”
看着面前的凶猿，他的眼神变得凶狠了起来。
“是你?”
“接近上千人份的源质，你该不会以为我能吸收的了吧？”凶猿挠着面具后面露出的斑驳白发，反问道：“我要是有那个本事，早就成为了上主之一，哪里轮得到被你呼来喝去？拿到的时候它就是空的了。
与其威胁我，你不如先想想怎么跟上主他们交代吧——因为你私自使用圣物牟利，导致放牧十二年积攒的源质丢失……”
“你也分了钱！”
男人失态地咆哮，死死地瞪着它：“如果事发了，别想你会好的了！”
凶猿没有说话，只是沉默地摩擦着手指，铁的指甲彼此碰撞，发出尖锐地声音，直到那个人的眼神从自己身上移开。
“你自己的手下出了叛徒，才导致这件圣物落在了其他人手里，我为上主夺回了圣物，自有功劳，纵然有错，也不至于招致’绝罚’。”凶猿冷声说：“我要是你，现在肯定会想想补救的办法。
不就是丢了么？只要在上主们发现之前找回来不就好了？”
“你说得轻松！”男人愤怒地瞥了他一眼：“哪里有那么简单？”
“那些老头儿老娘们不是都快死了么？干脆废物利用了算了……这样至少还能挽回一点损失。”凶猿轻描淡写地说道：“至于那上千人份的源质，肯定不会就这么消失无踪。不论是用来进阶、续命还是倒手，都需要时间。”
几分钟之后，密室中传来了阴沉的声音。

“给我查！究竟还有谁碰过这个盒子！”
content_en:
Behind the one-way mirror, in the awkward silence, everyone in the Special Affairs Department couldn't help but touch the guns at their waists, hoping to silence the embarrassing thing before the news spread.
Only Ai Qing remained calm. She just took a sip of coffee, then took out a pair of thick sunglasses from the pocket of her wheelchair and put them on her face.
"Continue."
The middle-aged man hesitated for a moment, sighed, and ordered through the microphone on the table: "Continue."
It took a long time before Brother Yi came to his senses from such an awkward encounter. He brushed his hair hanging in front of his eyes, smiled warmly, and reached out:
"Little brother, let me meet you. My name is Liu Dongli..."
"Shit! Only a ghost wants to get to know you!"
Huai Shi was furious. Now he finally came to his senses. He pointed his cuffed fingers at Liu Dongli and shouted out the door: "Comrade leader, I want to report this person. He is engaged in illegal industry and is simply a leader... Don't be deceived by him!"
"..."
Liu Dongli sighed helplessly, then suddenly raised a finger and placed it in front of Huai Shi: "Look at my finger."
"I don't!"
No matter how stupid she was, Huai Shi knew something was wrong. She didn't want to jump into his pit, so she raised her head and accidentally... saw his face.
The fair skin and slender neck, a pair of eyes as deep as the ocean, a few strands of gold hidden between the long hair are like twinkling stars in the universe, a few strands of hair fall between his eyebrows, covering the pair of eyes that are like cold stars on a winter night, the tall and straight bridge of the nose shows the virility of a man...
"Oh hoo!"
Huai Shi was fascinated by it for a while, but she didn't know why and suddenly felt nauseous.
He secretly blamed himself, how could he see someone who was prettier than himself being so ugly? He struggled to squeeze out a smile on his livid face, but saliva leaked from the corner of his mouth...
The whole person became demented in an instant.
He held Liu Dongli's little hand and rubbed it to keep it from relaxing. He said in a familiar tone: "Brother, where do you work? Oh, I'm so sorry for being so rude last time. Let me introduce myself. My younger brother Huai Shi, I'm seventeen this year. Do you still remember me?"
"..."
At this moment, it wasn't just Huai Shi. Everyone who saw Liu Dongli behind the one-way mirror couldn't help but let out an "oh" sound. Even the middle-aged man who had always been the most serious blushed, his heart trembled, and he turned away and coughed softly.
Only Ai Qing, who was wearing large sunglasses, still drank coffee calmly, stretched out her hand and pressed the call button: "I didn't ask you to come here to let you be wild. Control your soul radiation and do business."
"Okay, okay."
Liu Dongli raised his fingers to adjust the black-rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose. He sat opposite Huai Shi with a smile as gentle as autumn water. He asked: "Little brother, we have gotten to know each other. Can you answer a few questions?"
"Okay, okay."
Huai Shi grabbed his hand and didn't let go, drooling, looking like a fool: "Brother, I will tell you whatever you ask, my bank card password is 18191..."
"Ahem, that's not necessary."
Liu Dongli waved his hand quickly, then opened the file in his hand and coughed lightly: "Where were you last night?"
"I was at home, sleeping, and had several nightmares that scared me to death. Let me tell you..."
"Only sleeping?" Liu Dongli interrupted and asked, not interested in hearing what nightmares he had.
"Yes."
Huai Shi nodded, "Who would be scared to run away with nothing to do in the middle of the night, and it rained so heavily last night, so I'm crazy before going out. Let me tell you, although our family is a bit broken, our ancestors are still good..."
"Ahem, next question." Liu Dongli interrupted him again: "What is in the box you sent to the police station?"
"I don't know." Huai Shi shook his head crisply: "Who comes up here when they have nothing to do and is mad at people?Vomiting blood..."
In the next hour, Liu Dongli repeatedly asked complicated questions in the file, disrupted the order, and even suddenly asked irrelevant questions.
Until Ai Qing's voice came from behind the one-way mirror: "That's it. "
He finally breathed a sigh of relief and gathered his strength to pull his wrist out of Huai Shi's hand. It was full of red marks. Fortunately, he pulled it out early. If it had been later, the grandson would have broken it.
The moment he took a deep breath, Huai Shi suddenly woke up from his dementia and looked at him blankly, not knowing what happened.
It was as if he had a nightmare, a nightmare that was so real that he began to spit on himself...
"Ugh! "
He stood up from the chair suddenly, being handcuffed and unable to get up. He bent over in embarrassment and vomited violently. He felt indescribably nauseated when he thought about how he had just felt like spring. He vomited until his nose and tears almost flowed out.
"Damn pervert, what did you do to me! vomit! "
Before he finished speaking, he started vomiting again, and couldn't help but cry while vomiting.
"Oh my god, I don't even have a girlfriend, why did I get swayed by this pervert? I've lost my reputation, I've lost my reputation, I'll fight you, you bastard! "
“Sorry, no one wants this to happen. "
Liu Dongli seemed to have been used to such scenes for a long time. He handed over a glass of water sympathetically: "The most important thing in life is to be happy. Are you hungry? I..."
"Ugh! "
Before he finished speaking, Huai Shi vomited again.
At this moment, behind the one-way mirror, there were also sounds of vomiting and nausea.
The middle-aged man's face was livid, and he pressed his painful stomach. The person next to him handed over a stomach medicine and a well-placed glass of warm water.
It was the female driver behind Ai Qing who had been following her silently.
"Thank you. He smiled reluctantly, took the medicine, and breathed for a long time before finally calming down a little.
"How's it going? "Ai Qing said, "I told you earlier, I can't ask anything. "
"Maybe it's just pretending..."
The middle-aged man coughed dryly: "I know Liu Dongli's soul ability, it has a charm effect, right? Although it is effective for ordinary people, sublimators may not fall for it. "
"Is it still unclear whether Liu Dongli was hit or not? Besides, if there is any man, any man who is at the peak of his self-esteem and sexual desires, can pretend to this extent... I don't think you can figure it out no matter how hard you think of it. "
Ai Qing looked at him deeply and said, "Give up. "
“I’ve read the file, and if I’m talking about that brat’s criminal suspicion, I’m actually his alibi. "
Liu Dongli walked in from the interrogation room, threw the filled files back on the table, and sighed helplessly: "That kid was still interviewing in our club three minutes before the explosion at the port..."
"Interview? What can he interview for? "
"Being a Cowherd... seems to have been deceived by an agency, right? I found out halfway through the interview that I was scared away by the supervisor. "
Liu Dongli shook his head, looking at the frontal photo of Huai Shi on the file, holding his chin and sighing: "If you ask me, he has quite a lot of potential, and he has a good attitude, but it's a pity that he doesn't dress well. If he changes into a slim suit and dresses, and removes the shameless smile on his face, he will be a pure abstinence type. Old aunts like this kind of little hedgehog that can't be eaten the most..."
"Okay, I didn't call you here to help him make career plans. "
Ai Qing interrupted him, "He is just an ordinary person who was accidentally involved in the incident. Let him go after signing the confidentiality agreement. Staying here is a waste of time. "
That's how it was decided.
Fifteen minutes later, Huai Shi, whose heart was ravaged, signed a lot of things and was put into the car and sent away.
In front of the gate, Liu Dongli put his hands in his pockets and looked at the struggling young man who thought he was going to be shot. He couldn't help but let out a sigh.laughed.
"By the way, what's his name?" He looked at Ai Qing behind him.
"Sophora poems."
"Do you know him?" Liu Dongli smiled mysteriously, "That's why you helped him out, right? Don't underestimate the intuition of the golden cowherd, Miss Ai."
Unexpectedly, Ai Qing's expression remained calm.
"Ah, we know each other."
"Very familiar?"
"I can't say, I'm three years older than him, and I played pretty well with him when I was little."
"Eh?" Liu Dongli turned around in surprise, never expecting that there was such a connection between the two: "What happened next?"
"Later?"
Ai Qing glanced at him and said, "We haven't seen each other since his family went bankrupt because of my grandfather's breach of trust and breach of contract."
"..."
Liu Dongli was stunned, not knowing what to say.
In the closed basement, someone pushed the door open and entered.
The restless man jumped up from his chair, looking anxious: "Why is it so late?"
"Do you think that the movement last night was so small that no one noticed it?" The blood-stained murderous ape squatted on the chair, giggling strangely, "Thanks to you, I have experienced a lot of addiction..."
"Where's the stuff?"
The man stretched out his hand anxiously: "Did you get the things back?"
A plastic bag soaked in blood was thrown into his arms, "It returns to its original owner, but..."
The man was overjoyed at first, but the moment he took the bag, his expression changed. He opened the bag like crazy, took out the black iron box, and carefully
But it was empty inside.
"Where's the stuff?!"
He screamed: "Where is the sefirah inside? Where did the sefirah that I accumulated for so long go?"
Looking at the ferocious ape in front of him, his eyes became fierce.
"Is it you?"
"You don't think I can absorb the essence that is close to thousands of people, do you?" The ferocious ape scratched the mottled white hair exposed behind the mask and asked: "If I had that ability, I would have become one of the lords long ago. Where would I get to be called around and drank by you? It was empty when I got it.
Instead of threatening me, you should first think about how to explain to the Lord and the others - because you privately used holy objects to make profits, you lost the essence accumulated over twelve years of grazing..."
"You got a share of the money too!"
The man roared uncontrollably and stared at it: "If this happens, don't think you will be fine!"
The ferocious ape did not speak, but rubbed his fingers silently, and the iron nails collided with each other, making a sharp sound, until the man looked away from himself.
"You had a traitor among your own men, which caused this sacred object to fall into the hands of others. I took back the sacred object for the Lord. I have my own merits. Even if I make a mistake, it will not lead to 'excommunication.'" The fierce ape said coldly: "If I were you, I would definitely think of a remedy now.
Isn't it just lost? Wouldn't it be nice to just find it before the Lords find out? "
"You said it was easy!" The man glanced at him angrily: "How can it be so easy?"
"Aren't those old men and women about to die? Let's just reuse the waste... This way we can at least recover some losses." The fierce ape said lightly: "As for the source of thousands of people, it will definitely not disappear without a trace. Whether it is used to advance, renew life, or turn over, it will take time."
A few minutes later, a gloomy voice came from the secret room.
"Check it for me! Who else has touched this box!"
